verdicts.note: ESC/ABS faults are mentioned but described as resolved years earlier; the live complaint is repeated power steering failure.

Both gpt-5.4 models said UNKNOWN OR OTHER, and our own definition backs them: the narrative describes hesitation on acceleration, names no part, and reports no diagnosis, which is exactly the 'vague drivability complaint with no specific part named' case. Consistent with the earlier adjudication of 347953.
Battery and stop/start warning lights precede a loss of power steering. The electrical fault is the apparent root cause and the steering loss is the experienced failure; both labels are supported.
BORDERLINE: two models said POWER TRAIN, but the only diagnostic clue in the text is a battery fault light, and POWER TRAIN's definition requires loss of power tied to the drivetrain.
gpt-5-mini's LATCHES/LOCKS/LINKAGES is wrong -- that class is defined as door/hood latches and their linkages, not the gear shifter.

CONSISTENCY FLAG: the narrative describes an inoperable electronic brake control but literally quotes 'NHTSA Campaign Number: 22V193000 (Electrical System)', and gold is ELECTRICAL SYSTEM. Since the campaign's category name appears verbatim in the text, the label IS recoverable here -- which argues the excluded row 1981710 (same pattern) should be un-excluded rather than dropped.

CORRECTED after user pushback on deferring to NHTSA: I need to decide, not average two NHTSA rows. This narrative has no airbag symptom at all (no warning light, no deployment fear, no malfunction) -- it's purely 'the dashboard cracked... I do not know what caused the crack.' That is STRUCTURE by its own definition. Contrast 1293783, which explicitly states 'FEAR OF AIRBAG DEPLOYING' -- an actual airbag-system concern, correctly AIR BAGS there. The two rows are not textually identical, so there's no real inconsistency once read carefully. gpt-5-mini and gpt-5.4-nano's AIR BAGS answers here are wrong.
A failed brake hose is a genuine hydraulic-specific detail, so unlike the subtype-less brake rows this one really is SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC.
